title: Chintamani Library v2.8.2 — Strictly 9 Lockers per Branch, Omni Global Search & Functional Notifications
releaseNotes: LOCKERS FIX: Enforced exactly 9 lockers (L01–L09) for both Khalilabad and Mehdawal branches across backend and mobile
OMNI GLOBAL SEARCH: Rebuilt search engine to search across Members, Single Hall Seats (K01–K72 / M01–M65), 9 Lockers (L01–L09), and all Core Services with instant navigation
FUNCTIONAL NOTIFICATIONS: Connected dashboard notification bell with active unread badge and rich notification center featuring dues alerts, system backup logs, and operational timings
TACTILE DASHBOARD HEADER: Upgraded Search and Notification buttons with luxury glass containers and crisp haptic feedback
